messages.subject: Weekly M&A Briefing: UK mid-market deal volumes tick up
messages.plaintextBody: This week's briefing: UK mid-market M&A volumes rose 6% in Q4 as sponsors deployed dry powder into industrials and software. Plus: W&I claims trends, and the latest on the National Security and Investment Act. Read online. To unsubscribe, click here.
